title: Regional capacity signal — weekly snapshot (clusters & pools) 2025-09-07
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is an operational snapshot exported from the cluster-level dashboard for the week ending 2025-09-07. It focuses on capacity signals across regions (NA/EU/APAC) broken down by cluster and pool. The goal is to highlight short-term hotspots, pools trending toward saturation, and candidate pools for burst expansion or pre-warming.

Executive summary:
- Overall fleet average GPU utilization (time-weighted) across sampled clusters: 64%.
- NA clusters show the highest variance: west-1 peaking to 89% sustained in 6hr window on 2025-09-05; east-2 remained steady 58–66%.
- EU region steady but slowly increasing on quantized batches; quantized-serving pools need attention (see action items).
- APAC regional pool had one 2-hour saturation event tied to nightly transfer jobs (ticketed).

Key observations (per cluster/pool):
Cluster | Region | Pool | Avg GPU util (%) | 95th pct latency (ms) | Nodes active | Peak window | Notes
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cluster-west-1 | NA | gen-infer-prod | 74 | 62 | 48 | 2025-09-05 03:00-09:00 UTC | sustained high during partner batch; KV cache hit low
cluster-east-2 | NA | chat-low-latency | 58 | 34 | 36 | 2025-09-03 12:00-15:00 UTC | stable, normal tail-latency
cluster-eu-1  | EU | quant-serve-4 | 81 | 78 | 40 | 2025-09-06 20:00-22:00 UTC | quantized model pop; jitter on scheduling
cluster-eu-2  | EU | gen-burst | 47 | 45 | 28 | 2025-09-04 00:00-02:00 UTC | underutilized, candidate for rebuild
cluster-apac-1 | APAC | nightly-transfer | 69 | 120 | 12 | 2025-09-05 11:00-13:00 UTC | ETL windows coincided with inference traffic spike

Daily trend highlights (2025-09-01 -> 2025-09-07):
- 2025-09-01: Fleet avg 58% — normal baseline after weekend dip.
- 2025-09-03: Minor spike correlated with A/B rollout for chat model (east-2).
- 2025-09-05: West-1 sustained utilization >85% for a 6hr window; multiple request retries recorded.
- 2025-09-06: Quant-serve-4 in EU had elevated latency and autoscaler thrash (see linked INFRA-823).

Anomalies and root-cause notes:
1) cluster-west-1 elevated utilization: tracing shows a mix of scheduled offline batch jobs from a partner account overlapping with customer traffic; autoscaler did not add nodes due to annotation mismatch on pool label (label: \"partner-batch\" vs expected \"partner-burst\").
2) cluster-eu-1 quantized pool jitter: kernel selection fallback triggered on lane 2; suspect a new quantized kernel rollout in runtime 1.18. Patch candidate in PR 412.
3) cluster-apac-1 nightly-transfer: ETL job altered network priority; inference queueback caused request piling and increased tail latency. Ops ticket created: INFRA-839.

Short-term recommendations (0–72 hours):
- Add temporary burst nodes to cluster-west-1 gen-infer-prod controlled by schedule: windows 02:00–10:00 UTC for next 7 days. (Owner: Ethan)
- Patch runtime kernel on eu-1 to v1.18.2-rollup (PR 412) and run canary on quant-serve-4 with reduced traffic. (Owner: Marisol)
- Adjust ETL job priority in apac to avoid overlapping peak inference hour; coordinate with data-platform. (Owner: Jared)

Capacity delta calculations (rough):
- West-1 gen-infer-prod: to bring 95th down from 89% to <75% requires +12 GPUs (4 nodes x 3 GPUs) during peak windows.
- EU quant-serve-4: short-term buffer of +6 GPUs while patch validated.

Operational playbook references used for decisions:
- Autoscaler policy: conservative-add (scale step: 2 nodes per 60s) — currently active in west-1 and eu-1.
- Cache warm strategy: prefix pre-warm during scheduled bursts (samples run on 2025-09-02).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want partner-batch traffic moved to a dedicated pool for west-1 to isolate spikes? (pro/con analysis needed)
- Should quantized-serving pools have a stricter kernel rollout gating in the console?
- Confirm if apac nightly ETL re-schedule is acceptable to product owners.

Next steps:
1) Ethan to create scheduled capacity job and submit change to infra-scheduler by 2025-09-08.
2) Marisol to coordinate PR 412 rollout and report back end-to-end metrics in next snapshot.
3) Jared to open coordination call with data-platform for ETL reschedule by 2025-09-09.

Appendix (raw samples exported):
- Hourly util sample (west-1 gen-infer-prod): [52, 57, 61, 68, 74, 81, 86, 88, 85, 78, 71, 66, 60, 54, 50]
- Node churn events (eu-1 quant-serve-4): [scale_out@2025-09-06T20:05, scale_in@2025-09-06T20:18, scale_out@2025-09-06T20:30]

Notes to reviewer:
- This is intended as an operational working snapshot for infra on-call and capacity planning; please add edits inline with specific node counts or when follow-up tickets are created.
- If you need CSV of raw metrics, use dashboard export ID: dash-2025-09-07-InfraCap (ask Ethan for access).
